fields.statement: At 5f216aec2: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestWebPause|TestWebActionsOnly' passed (pause/resume forms carry the CSRF field, absent without a token or with none set; daemon and project pause/resume POSTs reach Actions.Pause; missing or wrong CSRF is 403 and runs nothing; POSTs to /retry, /abandon, /merge, /actions/{retry,abandon,merge}, /runs/R1/retry, /api/daemon.set and others are 404/405). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWebPauseAction passed through WebProjectHandler and WebRootHandler at /p/repo, reading rhiza.daemon.paused and rhiza.project.paused back through daemon.settings after daemon.set. The full ./internal/web package and the commit's ./internal/api Web|Inbox|Describe|Docs|Signoff|ReadOnly run both passed. Diff read: only web pause wiring, its template/CSS and tests; no TODOs; the form's action="/actions/pause" is rewritten under /p/<project>/ by scope.rewrite. make self-check failed only on the verifier's own unrendered actor (claude-code-1fc45f09.md and index.md); the parent commit fails identically in a clean detached worktree, so it is from the run environment, not the leaf.
